subject: Following up on MedViz
body:
Hi Dr. Brooks,

Following up in case my earlier note got buried.

I'm still looking for a few oral and maxillofacial surgeons who can spend a few minutes with MedViz and tell me, very directly, whether the workflow is useful or not.

If you're open to it, I can send a short demo path or you can try the live app here: https://medviz-web-editor.vercel.app/

If this is not relevant for you, no reply needed.

Thanks,
Emmanuel
